graph.conservative_boundary_record: Only six common boundary nodes; input:supplied->gate:structural, gate:configuration->join:result, gate:structural->join:result, gate:resource->join:result, join:result->owner:publication. Non-resource/result/publication predicates are unqualified_callback_boundary_only. No state/operand/numerical-output nodes, no caller source inspection or purity/readiness/execution admission claim.

job.joins: Every task belongs to exactly one job_scope/component/partition; each component belongs to one partition; all references must exist, memberships agree, barrier graph acyclic. execution_scope_id=sha256(b"eq142-job1\0" + canonical JSON of mode/configured_workers/tasks/resource budget). job.barrier_policy: Pool shutdown and global_worker_shutdown_barrier apply only when mode is thread/process. Sequential has no executor/pool and omits those requirements. Resource, component order, all selected outcomes, full task result and serialized publication ownership remain. This source-correct clarification resolves initial implementation review EQ142GRAPH02; no scheduler or numerical behavior changed.

native_thread_method.selected: New development sampler extension in tools/eq142_native.py; Windows CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS), Process32FirstW/Process32NextW, PROCESSENTRY32W.cntThreads joined only to verified owned-Job member PIDs. No command lines, executable paths or unrelated process details persisted.
native_thread_method.qualification: Before timing, test successful process/thread observations, invalid snapshot/enumeration, missing-member race, membership, descendants and cleanup. Original supplied_native.py does not already provide thread counts. Missing/racing measurement is an explicit probe error, never zero or configured degree. A positive signaled retained owned process handle (WaitForSingleObject WAIT_OBJECT_0) may prove termination and zero current execution threads; retain observed_terminated/terminal_wait/snapshot_threads explicitly. This is a terminal proof, never a missing/live/racing measurement default. Unknown/live absent member, open, membership, snapshot, enumeration or wait errors still reject qualification. Snapshot and final handle observations are not atomic and may miss transient peaks.
native_thread_method.limitations: Sampled counts can miss transient thread/process peaks. Membership and snapshot are not atomic. Observer CPU/RSS is excluded from owned-Job accounting; whole-run wall includes observation/report completion. No physically enforced memory/CPU or globally idle-host claim.

local_trace_fragment.limits: Each fragment independently closes local event IDs, same-timeline parent relations, acyclic depth<=64, interval union/exclusive identity and counter/byte joins. It is not the complete source/product/native sample envelope. Encoded sidecar bytes are bounded separately from Python heap; actual whole-Job RSS remains mandatory. Partial raw evidence is retained on rejection. Shared actual timeline identities remain stable across reused invocations.
local_trace_fragment.publication: Exclusive temporary creation and exclusive hard-link final publication; never replace an existing final file. Both temporary/final names count toward the file bound; no physical durability claim.
